facts.label: Agora e planos
facts.sub: Use am/is/are + -ing para agora: I’m running. Use am/is/are going to + verbo para planos: I’m going to have breakfast.

facts.label: Agora
facts.sub: Para falar do que acontece agora, use am/is/are + -ing: I’m running. He’s walking his dog. Os pássaros estão cantando: The birds are singing. Use now, today ou right now.

facts.label: Planos
facts.sub: Para planos, use am/is/are going to + verbo: I’m going to have breakfast. Pergunte Are you going to run again? A resposta curta: Yes, I am. No, I’m not.
